sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Pat Collections Mortgage Bank Limited (also known as Pat Collections Real Estate Finance Co) is a licensed financial services institution dedicated to making property ownership accessible to Nigerians. Led by experienced capital markets professionals, we combine deep financial expertise with a genuine understanding of the Nigerian real estate market. Our mission is to provide transparent, efficient, and customer-focused mortgage banking services that empower individuals and families to achieve their homeownership goals. We are committed to upholding the highest standards of financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and customer service excellence.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Residential Mortgages: Flexible mortgage plans designed for first-time homebuyers and property upgraders, with competitive interest rates and convenient repayment terms.

Commercial Real Estate Financing: Tailored financing solutions for commercial property acquisition, development, and investment opportunities.

Home Equity Loans: Unlock the value in your property with our home equity financing options for renovations, education, or business expansion.

Mortgage Advisory: Expert guidance through every step of the mortgage process, from application to final approval, ensuring you make informed decisions.

Property Investment Financing: Specialized financing packages for real estate investors looking to expand their property portfolios.

Refinancing Solutions: Competitive refinancing options to help you reduce monthly payments or access better mortgage terms.

sections.name: Why Choose Pat Collections
sections.copy:
Experienced Leadership: Backed by seasoned capital markets analysts who understand both finance and real estate dynamics.

Competitive Rates: We offer some of the most competitive mortgage rates in the Nigerian market, making homeownership more affordable.

Fast Processing: Our streamlined approval process ensures quick turnaround times, getting you into your home faster.

Personalized Service: Every client receives individual attention and customized mortgage solutions that fit their unique financial situation.

Transparency: No hidden fees, no surprises. We believe in clear communication and honest dealings throughout your mortgage journey.

Regulatory Compliance: Fully licensed and regulated, giving you peace of mind that your investment is secure and protected.
